_why: PERMISSION, NOT OWNERSHIP. The first version of this asked 'who owns this secret' and gave it to nobody else. That is too blunt for how these departments actually work: Legal, Trust and Accounting all operate in finance and share resources constantly. An agent does not need to OWN a resource to read it - it needs permission, and permission is a grant somebody wrote down.
_model: Each resource carries an owner and three grant lists. Ownership is the DEFAULT GRANT - the owner always has read, write and execute - and every other agent is explicit. That keeps the common case short without making sharing impossible.
_fails_closed: This is the INTERIOR. A resource with no entry is denied to everyone, an unreadable file denies everything, and an action not listed is not granted. The perimeter guard (check_guard) still fails OPEN on purpose - a Security Agent that is restarting must not halt a grow reading - and the two directions are deliberate. An outage should not stop work; an outage must not grant access.

credential:COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN.why: CourtListener is Legal's live column. No other department queries dockets, so nobody else is granted - but the grant list exists, so granting is an edit and not a rewrite.

credential:SOLANA_RPC_URL.why: THE URL IS THE CREDENTIAL - it embeds the QuickNode key. Trading only, and no grant list entries.

credential:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.why: Only the Inference Service calls a cloud model. An agent holding this key could bypass config/model_routing.json entirely.

credential:INFERENCE_MODEL.why: Not a secret. A model name.

credential:OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE.why: Not a secret. A cache duration.

ledger:finance_shared.why: THE CASE THAT OWNERSHIP GOT WRONG. Accounting owns the books; Legal needs to read them to test whether an instrument operates as claimed, and Trust to test whether a beneficial interest is borne out. Both read, NEITHER writes - a department that could write another's ledger could make its own reading true.

corpus:legal_agent.why: ask_peer_corpus depends on this. A department borrows a sibling's authority rather than shelving a second copy, so read is granted and write never is - two writable copies of an authority is two sources of truth.

corpus:grow_agent.why: Nothing outside the grow reasons about horticulture.

case:hud_vash.why: A case is ONE object shared by several departments - that is the whole design. Accounting writes because it records obligations and payments against the matter; Trust and Anansi read only. The principal's live HUD-VASH matter.
